wheel_unit: Target rad/s; feedback reported interface values, physical scale unverified.
initial_window_policy: Original anchored validate, first qualifying >=3-second static window with >=25 synchronized source-time pairs; no refit.
endpoint_window_policy: First complete fixed 15-second window from final zero command +4 through +19 seconds; missing intervals are retained. Separate original static validation also recorded.
distance_window_policy: Same motion-boundary definition as baseline: first nonzero final chassis command through first zero after last arrival nonzero plus 1 s; continuous native base_link source stamps; report gaps and do not bridge intervals >0.5 s.
endpoint_policy: Measure arrival error after middle correction; no endpoint correction in this requested run.
middle_pause_recovery: First planned hold lacked fresh mocap. No correction applied. Original route remains paused; all attempts retained. Resume only with fresh native pose and seek fresh mocap.
pause_reason: Operator requested to keep vehicle parked; original route remains paused. Recording ended gracefully. No automatic departure or restart.
experimental_limitations: Long stationary operator/debugging pause before middle correction
After middle correction operational native age allowance 3.0 s; continuation speed capped at 0.10 m/s and yaw rate 0.15 rad/s; frozen source navigation configuration unchanged
No endpoint mocap correction requested; measure arrival error only
Static recording split while parked; missing native odometry intervals are not bridged
recording_storage_policy: Keep original full path once at endpoint; remaining native/mocap/command samples continue without repeated full-history Path payloads.
